segments.en: "How precious is Your kindness, Hashem — that we have heard the story of the one who has the power in his hands to heal the daughter of the King — and to take out from her all the arrows, etc. And her entire healing is through joy — that comes through him — through the ten kinds of melody. Fortunate are you — that you do not oppose such a wonder, etc."
